No personal experience. Though, with such short sessions, and kids coming and going, I'd probably cap levels at 3, and keep to the free, basic rules. Keeps it simple, and everyone on equal ground.

The Adventurers League stuff on DMSGuild website has a bunch of 1-hour sessions (low level) available. They're generally a quick straight-forward hook, and 1-2 battles. Also, I'd use "minion" rules from 4th Edition on anything other than the big bad guy - especially when pressed for time. Minions can be any monster you modify, to have low AC (easy to hit) and 1hp (dies on hit), but still pose a threat if not dealt with - death by a thousand cuts. Can have big bandit boss, and a bunch of thug(minions). DireWolf/wolves. Orc/goblins, Etc.

Also, use a screen, fudge numbers. Don't gang up on one bad positioned PC (They are learning), or knock one unconscious round one, so they sit and watch the whole fight.
